name: Digital Anatomy · MediJet
summary: J850 and J5 Digital Anatomy and J5 MediJet: anatomical models that look and feel like real tissue.

page.page_title: Digital Anatomy and MediJet Medical PolyJet
page.description: Stratasys Digital Anatomy · MediJet 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.eyebrow: Stratasys Digital Anatomy · MediJet · Medical PolyJet
page.headline: Life-like anatomical models,
page.lead: J850 and J5 Digital Anatomy print models that replicate the look, feel and response of human tissue. J5 MediJet adds biocompatible, sterilisable guides and multicolour models in a compact system.
page.footnote: Source: stratasys.com J850 Digital Anatomy, J5 Digital Anatomy and J5 MediJet pages, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: The look, feel and response of real tissue.

features.title: Full colour
features.text: Colour-coded anatomy for planning and teaching.

features.title: Biocompatible and sterilisable (MediJet)
features.text: Approved materials support steam, gamma, VHP and EtO sterilisation.

benefits.title: Cost
benefits.text: MediJet: 30 % lower cost per part than outsourcing (Stratasys claim).

specs.label: Models
specs.value: J850 Digital Anatomy, J5 Digital Anatomy, J5 MediJet

specs.label: Layer thickness
specs.value: J850 DA: 14 µm (High Quality, 7 materials), 27 µm, 54 µm · J5: down to 18 µm

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: J850 DA: ±100 µm under 100 mm; ±200 µm or ±0.06 % over 100 mm · J5: ±150 µm under 100 mm; ±0.15 % over 100 mm (rigid materials)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Digital Anatomy: TissueMatrix, BoneMatrix, GelMatrix, RadioMatrix · MediJet: MED615RGD, DraftWhite, Elastico, Digital ABS Plus

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print (Digital Anatomy); Digital Anatomy Creator and GrabCAD Print Pro optional

specs.label: System size & weight
specs.value: J850 DA: 1,400 × 1,260 × 1,100 mm · 430 kg, plus material cabinet · J5: 651 × 661 × 1,511 mm · 228 kg

specs.label: Power
specs.value: J850 DA: 100–120 VAC 13.5 A or 220–240 VAC 7 A, 1 phase · J5: 100–240 VAC, 10 A, 1 phase

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE, FCC, EAC. The printers are not FDA-cleared medical devices.

applications.title: Education and research
applications.text: Hands-on training and simulation, including dental presets.
